title: Crunchyroll Deals: Here’s How to Save Up to 80% Off Select Subscription Plans
summary: The streaming service is offering discounted pricing on subscription plans until May 21.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Crunchyroll is celebrating the month of “Ani-May” with deep discounts on subscriptions. The anime streaming service is cutting subscription pricing, giving proud otakus the ability to watch all the anime they can stand at a fraction of the price.

Right now, new and returning members can get three months of Crunchyroll’s “Fan” membership for $1.99 per month (regularly $9.99 per month) , or three months of the “Mega Fan” membership for $2.99 per month (regularly $13.99 per month) . These offers span across more than 35 countries, including the United States, and will run through Thursday, May 21.

The price drop comes at an amazing time, with new releases such as  Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc ,  Witch Hat Atelier and  Daemons of the Shadow Realm available to stream on the platform. There’s also a ton of Crunchyroll Anime Awards standouts to stream, such as Solo Leveling ,  Apothecary Diaries,   My Hero Academia ,  My Hero Academia   and  SPY X FAMILY , among others.

'Fan'

$1.99/month $9.99/month 80% off

Crunchyroll’s “Fan” membership is now $1.99 per month for three months.

With your subscription to either tier, you’ll gain access to Crunchyroll’s extensive library and membership perks. With your “Fan” membership , you’ll gain access to ad-free anime viewing, plus offline viewing and 5% off select products on Crunchyroll’s store.

Via the “Mega Fan” membership , you’ll gain access to ad-free anime viewing plus offline viewing, access to stream on a total of four devices at a time, 10-15% off select store merchandise, free shipping on select orders, access to the “Game Vault” (a curated library of premium mobile games) and exclusive early access to deals.

'Mega Fan'

$2.99/month $13.99/month 79% off

Crunchyroll’s “Mega Fan” membership is $2.99 per month for three months.

These deals are only available until Thursday, May 21. Unfortunately, offers exclude Crunchyroll’s “Ultimate Fan” membership ; however, there is a seven-day free trial that you can utilize if you’d like to test it out before committing to that $17.99 per month price tag.
